pre_condition: items is a finite list. size is a positive integer.
post_condition: Returns a list of N consecutive, non-overlapping sublists of items where N = ceil(len(items) / size). Each sublist i in [0, N-2] has length exactly size. The final sublist has length len(items) mod size when items is not evenly divisible by size, and size when it is. Element order within and across sublists matches the original order of items. When items is empty, returns an empty list.
